definition: Involving the direct sharing of thoughts between minds without speech.
author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
quote: One curious fact I discovered as I watched his thoughts was that the outer doors are manipulated by telepathic means.
example_sentence: The twins seem almost telepathic when they finish each other's sentences.
